_comment: Kotlin additions on top of java.json: Ktor (server routing, client, multipart, template content), Spring Kotlin / WebFlux coroutine extensions, Exposed, kotliquery, SQLDelight, kotlin.io / kotlin.io.path, Fuel, Android (Intent extras and data, WebView, SQLiteDatabase, ContentResolver).

sources.label: intent.{attr}
sources._comment: Android: the Intent that started an exported Activity / Service / BroadcastReceiver is attacker-controlled (Intent.getData(), getExtras())

sources.label: archive entry name {attr}
